candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms a right ovarian malignancy with peritoneal spread, but the benchmark diagnosis specifies large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma — a rare and distinct histologic subtype characterized by trabecular/rosette formations, pleomorphic hyperchromatic cells, high mitotic rate, and elevated NSE. C001 captures only the parent anatomical category without the neuroendocrine lineage or large cell subtype designation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the anatomical site (right ovary) and broad category (ovarian cancer) but lacks the specific histological subtype (large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma) required by the benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Elevated NSE (24.83 ng/mL) and CYFRA21-1 alongside CA-125 support neuroendocrine differentiation, consistent with large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma histology

Histologic description (trabecular/rosette architecture, pleomorphic hyperchromatic cells, high mitotic rate) is classic for large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma but immunohistochemistry (synaptophysin, chromogranin, CD56) not reported — diagnosis rests on morphology alone
